note: A small neutral sample. Replace it with your own rule pack: same shape, your own ids, wording and severities. kind is phrases (any phrase found), pattern (a regular expression, at most 200 characters) or needs_disclosure (a phrase found and none of the disclosures anywhere on the page). status is confirmed or draft; draft rules run only when include_draft_rules is on. question is what Clef is asked about the page for that rule; the Worker bundles id, label and question at deploy time, so redeploy it after adding a rule or changing a question. An unknown kind or a bad pattern stops the check with exit 2.

rules.label: Unsubstantiated superlative
rules.question: Does the page claim to be the best, the only or the leading option without saying what supports it?

rules.label: Unverifiable numeric claim
rules.question: Does the page state a percentage improvement without naming its source or basis?

rules.label: Missing disclosure
rules.question: Does the page promise a result without a nearby note that results vary or terms apply?

rules.label: Absolute claim (draft rule)
rules.question: Does the page say something always works or carries no risk?
